caveats.feltryckning: Votes against the party line are counted as recorded. Isolated cases can be feltryckningar (accidental button presses), which the riksdag keeps in the official record and the API reports unchanged.
caveats.kvittning: Frånvarande includes kvittning (pairing), where a member stays out by agreement with a member of the opposing side so the balance is unchanged. The open data does not distinguish kvittning from other absence, so participation is not a measure of diligence and is not ranked.
caveats.map: Coordinates come from a principal-component fit to party lines; axes are statistical summaries of voting patterns, not a left/right or any other named scale. Interpret them through the listed top-loading votes.

map.coordinate_scale: PCA scores and member solutions divided by sqrt(n map votes), so positions are comparable across periods of different length; loadings are the unit-norm PCA vectors
map.member_rule: least squares on the member's own cast map votes; at least 50 required
map.orientation: session rule: each axis's sign agrees with term-2022-26 -- the sign of the dot product of this map's and that map's party coordinates on the axis, over the parties in both; an axis with |cosine| < 0.1 falls back to the term rule (M positive on axis 1, V on axis 2); see orientation_axes. Axes are not left/right

title_sources.listing: one line per file, sorted by name: '<file> <sha256>\n'; every file is in manifest.json

rules.against_line: cast Ja/Nej/Avstår that differs from the member's party's non-null line (analysis set)
rules.agreement_ja_nej: share of votes, where both lines are Ja or Nej, with identical lines
rules.agreement_three_way: share of votes, where both parties have a line, with identical lines among Ja/Nej/Avstår
rules.blocs: latest approved statsministeromröstning of the term (chamber vote, avser frågan, title 'Prövning av (talmannens) förslag till statsminister'; rejected only if Nej >= 175 of 349); government_side = parties whose line was Ja, opposition = Nej, abstained = Avstår, no_line = tie or nobody cast; independents not placed
rules.cross_bloc: among parties with a line: not unanimous, and not bloc-aligned (all government_side parties on one line X, all opposition parties on one line Y != X; abstained parties ignored), and at least one government_side party shares its line with at least one opposition party; null when blocs is null
rules.map_orientation: term maps: anchor rule (axis 1 M positive, axis 2 V positive); session maps: each axis aligned with the term map's axis (sign of the dot product of party coordinates), anchor rule if |cosine| is small
rules.participation: share of analysis-set votes the member was seated for on which rost != Frånvarande
rules.party_line: plurality among the party's members voting Ja/Nej/Avstår (Frånvarande excluded); tie -> null and listed in ties; nobody cast -> null and listed in no_cast; parti '-' has no line

definitions.against_line: members casting Ja/Nej/Avstår different from their party's non-null line
definitions.cross_bloc: 1 = cross-bloc, 0 = not, null = no blocs; among parties with a line: not unanimous, and not bloc-aligned (all government_side parties on one line X, all opposition parties on one line Y != X; abstained parties ignored), and at least one government_side party shares its line with at least one opposition party; null when blocs is null

vote_flags.order: one entry per vote, in the order of party_lines.votes (all votes; party_lines.votes[i].analysis marks the analysis set)
